title: TenantGroupPractitioner
description: Represents the association of a practitioner with a tenant group.

effectiveDate.description: The date when the practitioner's affiliation with the tenant group becomes effective.

endDate.description: The date when the practitioner's affiliation with the tenant group ends.

employmentType.description: The type of employment relationship the practitioner has with the tenant group.

affiliationType.description: The type of affiliation the practitioner has with the tenant group (Delegated | Direct)
